findings: The company reports maintaining domestic offices in Mumbai (Head Office), New Delhi, Dehradun, and Bangalore.

The company has executed pan-India drone and aerial LiDAR mapping projects, including a 3D subsurface Ground Penetrating Radar survey across multiple Adani Group airports (Mumbai, Trivandrum, Lucknow, Jaipur, Guwahati, and Ahmedabad), a 2,500-km Ganga corridor project spanning four states (Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, and West Bengal), and 3D urban digital twin mapping in Kashi (Varanasi).

The rating rests on the company's verified deployment of large-scale drone and aerial LiDAR survey operations across multiple states and major airport infrastructures in India, supported by a network of domestic corporate offices.
